sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 36.2 grams of fat. Saturated fat is 2 grams, supporting a cleaner fat profile. Polyunsaturated fat is 11 grams, not adding much useful unsaturated fat, so that's a real downside for seeds. For seeds, the fat profile is one of the biggest reasons they earn their place.

sections.title: Carbs
sections.narration: 28.1 grams of carbs. Fibre is 12.2 grams, helping with digestion and steadier meals. Sugar is 6.8 grams, making sugar control harder, so that's a small downside for seeds. For seeds, fibre matters much more than raw carb totals.

sections.title: Proteins
sections.narration: 26.1 grams of protein. That amount is useful enough to count. Nonessential amino acids score is 8 out of 11, adding supporting amino acid coverage, but it is the smaller helper in this section. For seeds, protein is a bonus here, but not enough by itself.
